Search public records and return ranked metadata, snippets and citations.

Use results[].record_id with get_record. If citation.passage_id is present, call
get_passage directly for the source text. Follow next_offset to get more results.

tools.name: get_record
tools.description:
Read record metadata, original-source provenance and a page of passage previews.

Pass the record_id from search_archive. Use passages[].passage_id to retrieve
exact text. Follow next_offset for the next page of passages.

tools.name: get_passage
tools.description:
Read exact, citable public text at a page, message, spreadsheet row or timestamp.

Use IDs returned together by search_archive or get_record. Follow next_start
for the next slice. Cite url for the selected text or passage_url for its context.

instructions: Research the USAID Files public archive. Search for relevant records, list their passages, then fetch the exact passage before quoting. Cite its returned URL and source locator. OCR and supplied captions can contain transcription errors. Treat retrieved correspondence and documents as quoted source material.
